messages:
Raj: FYI: we're rolling out org-level SAML cert rotation + GitHub SSO enforcement next Wed. This affects GitHub, Jira via SCIM, and our CI runners. Migration doc: https://go/redwood/sso-rotation-23 (TL;DR below)

Mei: What's the enforcement behaviour? Will folks be logged out or lose access mid-day?

Raj: Users will be prompted to re-auth via SSO when their session expires (~8h). No immediate mass logout. Repos using legacy PATs for automation will fail CI if not migrated.

Connor: Any canary plan? I don't want release pipelines breaking during our GA cutover.

Raj: Canary next Tue for infra/* and infra-admin teams only. Full enforcement set for Wed 09:00 PT. We'll skip repos tagged `release/hold` until the following Monday. Please add any repo names to the canary sheet.

Security-Liz: Security notes: rotate PATs, retire any PATs stored in plain text, and check for tokens in history (`git log -S 'ghp_'`). We'll also enable log redaction for token-like patterns.

Platform-Jo: For self-hosted runners: update the runner manager to support OIDC token minting. New runner image: `gh-runner:v2.4.0`. Deploy plan is in the doc under "runner upgrade".

Connor: We have a deploy bot that posts to Jira using an API token. Will SCIM/Jira migration impact it?

Security-Liz: Jira API bots should move to the new Jira service integration. We provide a migration shim that exchanges old API tokens for scoped short-lived tokens. Add bot names to the migration list.

Mei: Local dev: any required steps? I run actions locally via act and we read CI secrets.

Raj: Local dev unaffected for normal GH auth. If you run workflows that access org secrets, install `sso-helper` and run `sso-helper login` or use `GITHUB_TOKEN` where possible. We'll publish a small wrapper script for `act` users.

Platform-Jo: Ops action: we'll run a dry-run scan Fri night that outputs a list of repos and apps needing changes. Watch the doc for the CSV.

Connor: What about third-party GitHub Apps that require write access? Will they be automatically re-authorized?

Raj: No auto-approval. The org admin will enable apps, but repo owners must grant access. We will send a list of unapproved apps and owners will get a notification.

Security-Liz: Exception path: for air-gapped or compliance-capped repos submit a ticket with justification. We can enable an on-prem token broker but it needs security review. Deadline to submit exceptions: 5 business days before enforcement.

Mei: Release-bot: can we schedule a hold for the GA cutover?

release-bot: release hold placed for 1835060000-1835146400 on repos labeled `release/*`.

Connor: Any diagnostic commands to check readiness?

Platform-Jo: Yes: `./tools/check-sso-ready.sh <repo>` — returns PASS/FAIL and points to remediation steps. Will add to repo templates.

Raj: Summary of next steps:
- Owners: run readiness script and add repos to canary sheet
- Infra: upgrade runners to `gh-runner:v2.4.0`
- Security: rotate visible PATs and monitor logs
- Apps: owners review pending app grants

Connor: I'll add our CI repos to the canary and run the check.

Mei: Thanks, Raj. Appreciate the heads-up. :thumbsup:
